sections.name: Noodle Soup Bowls
items: Original Thai Stories noodle soup with shrimp, chicken, rice noodles, beansprouts, scallions and cilantro in clear broth.

For those who love spicy. This is an authentic Thai style spicy noodle soup with shrimp, ground chicken, fish balls, rice noodle, beansprouts, ground peanuts, chilis, scallion and cilantro in hot and sour broth.
Northern Thailand style noodle soup with shrimp, chicken, soft egg noodles beansprouts, basil, scallions and cilantro in spicy curry soup.
Pork & Shrimp dumplings, chicken, shrimp, bean sprouts, scallion and cilantro in clear broth soup.
Famous Vietnamese style noodle soup with sliced beef, meatballs, rice noodles, onions, beansprouts, basil, scallions and cilantro in clear broth.
Roasted duck, rice noodles with Chinese broccoli, beansprouts, scallions and cilantro in duck broth.
